description: The bar chart illustrates the GPU memory usage in gigabytes (GB) for various fine-tuning methods, including Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, LoRA, QLoRA, and Ours. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis, while the vertical axis represents the GPU memory usage in GB, ranging from 0 to 60 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 20. Each category is represented by a bar, with the height indicating the corresponding GPU memory usage. The bars for Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, LoRA, and QLoRA are colored orange, while the bar for Ours is colored green. The GPU memory usage values are approximately 70 GB for Full FT, 40 GB for MTL-FT, 20 GB for TAG and LoRA, 10 GB for QLoRA, and 20 GB for Ours. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and the green bar for Ours is not visually emphasized beyond its color.
